Subject: CrescentHealth POC — request for extended runway and credit top-up

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. CrescentHealth is seeing promising results on the summarization flows — our clinical ops team reported a 30% reduction in triage time in a small pilot. We'd like to run a 6-week pilot against a larger dataset (additional 1.2M tokens anticipated) and want to request two things:

- A 45-day extension to the POC window (we're currently at day 18 of the 30-day PLG trial).
- A one-time credit top-up equivalent to $7,000 to cover extra inference usage during the extended pilot.

We understand this is outside standard PLG limits, but the team is on a tight timeline for an internal board review in mid-May and additional runway will materially de-risk our conversion. If we can get the extension + credit, CrescentHealth will commit to a 12-month paid contract post-pilot (we've budgeted for production). I'll attach our internal request summary and a draft PO for reference.

Attached: crescent_po_request.xlsx

Appreciate any way you can help escalate.

—Samir

Quick note on policy: our standard PLG trial includes 30 days and a baseline allowance (platform credit) intended to validate basic integration. Requests beyond that (multi‑week extensions and >$5k in one-off credits) require Deal Desk and exec sign-off. I've looped Laura (Sales Ops) and Jonas (CRO) to formalize the ask.

Laura / Jonas — could you review the attached summary and advise on a one-time variance? Key points: CrescentHealth is asking for 45-day runway and ~$7k credit; they indicate a confirmed intent to convert to a 12-month contract if the pilot demonstrates expected lift. Subject: Request: Executive approval — CrescentHealth POC credit uplift and runway extension

Jonas / team,

Putting a formal summary in the thread so we have a record for Deal Desk. The ask from CrescentHealth: a one-time 45-day extension to their POC window and a $7,000 credit top-up to cover ~1.2M additional tokens (they estimate conversion within 6–8 weeks post-pilot). This sits outside the standard PLG guardrails.

Recommendation (Sales Ops): grant a conditional concession to accelerate the deal:

- Offer: $5,000 one-time credit (applied to POC usage) + 30-day extension to the current trial window (i.e., 60 days total).
- Additional commercial sweetener: 15% discount on first three months of committed usage if they sign a 12-month contract within 30 days of pilot close.
- Conditions:
  - CrescentHealth signs a short addendum (SOW-draft.pdf) acknowledging pilot objectives and conversion milestone.
  - Finance to treat additional credit as a one-time concession (no recurring discount beyond the trial unless the contract is signed).
  - Legal to expedite NDA/SOW sign-off (we've attached a draft SOW).

Rationale: The customer is a mid-stage regional health system with clear plans to scale. The projected ARR from a full deployment (billing + usage) is material (> $180k ARR) and the risk of churn is low given clinical integration requirements. The $5k concession reduces friction and preserves standard precedent — we do not typically gift >$5k for PLG pilots without exec approval.

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, crescent_po_request.xlsx

Request: Jonas — please provide executive sign-off or alternate guidance. If approved, I'll notify CrescentHealth and have Legal/Finance prepare the addendum.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval — CrescentHealth POC credit uplift and runway extension

Thanks Laura — I appreciate the succinct recommendation. Approved with conditions:

- Approve $5,000 one-time credit applied to POC usage.
- Approve a 30-day extension to the POC window (60 days total).
- Approve the 15% commercial discount to the first three months only if CrescentHealth executes a 12-month contract within 30 days after pilot close.

Conditions / next steps:
1) Legal to fast-track the one-page SOW addendum and include the conversion milestone and success criteria.
2) Finance to record the concession against Deal Desk reserves and confirm accounting treatment.
3) Aditya to send an official approval email to Samir with the terms and attach the SOW draft; copy Laura, Legal, and Finance.
